description: Eastman Sigma 700VA/12V Square Wave Inverter is designed as an affordable yet capable backup solution for households and small businesses facing routine power cuts. The 700VA/12V rating supports core appliances such as fans, LED lights, televisions, set‑top boxes and Wi‑Fi routers, keeping daily life running smoothly during outages. Its TPZi square wave output and transformer‑based design are tuned for strong load performance and efficient battery charging, making it a practical choice where pure sine wave is not mandatory.The Sigma series integrates multiple intelligent protections to safeguard both equipment and users. Zero‑cross transition reduces electrical noise and stress when switching, while superior starting current handling manages motor loads more safely. A built‑in lightning protector and temperature guard help defend against surges and overheating, and the rapid “in‑a‑wink” changeover ensures near‑instant transfer from mains to UPS, minimising interruption to connected devices. Two‑step boost charging with CCCV control charges batteries quickly after an outage and then tapers current to preserve battery health and improve energy efficiency. With 36 months product warranty and a 10‑year transformer warranty, Eastman Sigma 700VA/12V offers strong long‑term value as a reliable, easy‑to‑install power backup system.
